Discs 3-4 and their episode titles were completed from the checked STAR TREK DE Season 1, Vol. 2 product listing.

The split release also contains Disc 5 with Special Features only. The supplied schema requires every Disc to contain at least one episode, so the extras-only Disc 5 cannot be represented as a Disc object without violating the schema.
The physical edition counts the two-part pilot as one printed episode; library numbering counts it as two episodes.
